title: France approves budget bill, suspends Macron's pension reform | AP News
text:
France approves budget bill, suspends Macron's pension reform | AP News

# French lawmakers narrowly approve health care budget, suspending Macron’s flagship pension reform

French Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu looks on at France’s National Assembly as parliament members vote on a national health care budget that would suspend Macron’s unpopular pension reform raising the retirement age, in Paris, France, Tuesday, Dec. 9, 2025. (AP Photo/Michel Euler)
